pov_scope: Assess or validate the fixed streaming progress endpoint through end-to-end testing.

functional_requirements.description: Support end-to-end testing of the fixed streaming progress endpoint.

notes: `progress_events` stores the ordered stream of observed progress messages/events for a run.

supports: Filter runs by endpoint path/environment/status/date range
Navigate to detail and inspection pages
Register a new queued validation run

notes: This is the only explicit requirement in the InitialPOVSpec and all designed artifacts map back to it.
The solution supports documentation, capture, playback, summary, and diagnosis of end-to-end validation runs; it does not define orchestration of the actual external test execution.

current_state.statement: A fixed streaming progress endpoint is being tested end to end.

open_questions.question: What business problem is this work intended to solve?
Who are the target users or personas for the streaming progress capability?
What does 'fixed' refer to—what issue was previously observed with the streaming progress endpoint?
Is the endpoint itself in scope for the POV, or only the testing/validation activity?
open_questions.notes: Designed artifacts scope the system to testing/validation activity and recording/inspection, not endpoint implementation or orchestration.

open_questions.question: What are the desired business outcomes or operational goals for this capability?
What systems or applications consume the streaming progress endpoint?
What metrics define successful end-to-end validation?
open_questions.notes: Artifacts support observed final state, pass/fail reasons, terminal event capture, invalid payload count, and out-of-order count, but no business-level success thresholds are specified.

open_questions.question: Are there any AI/GenAI requirements involved, or is this purely a non-AI technical capability?
open_questions.notes: All authoritative artifacts indicate a non-AI technical capability; no AI/GenAI requirements are defined.

non_goals_implied_by_contracts: No delete capability for test runs or progress events.
No editing of previously appended progress events.
No generic full-document update for test runs beyond lifecycle/status patching.
No live SSE/WebSocket subscription UI or backend contract.
No cross-run analytics dashboard beyond list filtering and per-run summary/anomaly inspection.
No pagination model beyond optional list limit.
